event.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle Exits as US Ambassador to Greece Amid Misconduct Allegations
event.canonical_title: Kimberly Guilfoyle Exits as US Ambassador to Greece Amid Misconduct Allegations
event.summary: Kimberly Guilfoyle has resigned from her position as the US ambassador to Greece following allegations of misconduct, including claims that she solicited a Trump donor to pay off her credit card debt in exchange for political access. President Trump confirmed her resignation, expressing dissatisfaction with the situation. Guilfoyle has stated that she will vigorously defend herself against the allegations.

timeline.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle Exits as US Ambassador to Greece Amid Misconduct Allegations
timeline.summary: Kimberly Guilfoyle has left her position as the US Ambassador to Greece following allegations of improper conduct, including claims that she sought $100,000 from a donor. The White House publicly requested her resignation as accusations mounted. Guilfoyle has denied the allegations, stating they are false and describing her ambassadorship as an 'honor of a lifetime.'
key_facts: Kimberly Guilfoyle left her position as US Ambassador to Greece.
Her exit followed allegations of improper conduct.
The White House requested her resignation amid mounting accusations.
